identity: Arabic translation (Hindawi Foundation, 2015) of 'The Challenge of Climate Change' by Robert L. Rothstein and Daniel D. Perlmutter. The excerpt runs from the very start of the book: title page, translator/reviewer credits, publisher colophon with postal address, phone, email, ISBN and the bilingual Arabic/English copyright block; then the two dedications, the acknowledgements section (شكر وتقدير), the complete preface (تمهيد), and the opening of Chapter One (الفصل الأول / البداية) including the numbered section heading ١ وجهة النظر المتبعة. Register: formal Modern Standard Arabic expository-argumentative nonfiction in translation, first-person plural authorial voice, heavy use of و- and فـ- clause chaining, interleaved with bibliographic boilerplate lines and two runs of untranslated English.
law: A sentence is ONE complete predication (verbal or nominal) together with everything syntactically dependent on it: relative clauses (الذي/التي/ما), complement clauses (أن/أنه/بأن), adverbial clauses (حتى، عندما، إذا، بحيث، ما دام، بينما، لما كان), purpose لـ-phrases, and tightly bound correlative frames (نظرا لأن...فـ، بما أن...فإن، لا...بل، ليس...فحسب ولكن أيضا، إن...وإنما، مهما كان...فإن). A boundary falls wherever a complete predication is followed by a NEW independent predication - and in this translator's hand that new predication very often begins with و or فـ, so the conjunction is NOT evidence against a break. Sentence openers attested in this document: وكذلك، كما، وأخيرا، ومن ثم، ولهذا السبب، في الواقع، ولكن، إلا أن، إن (inna), ليس + subject, فنحن/فبدأنا/فظهر/فهذه/ففي هذه الحالة، سوف/قد + verb, fresh VSO (يوجد، يحدونا الأمل، يرغب، كشف، وصف، استشهد، ونفى، وكانت النتيجة), fronted frames (في البداية، وفي هذه اللحظة، وبالنسبة إليهم، ولما كانت، ومن خلال، وفي كلا هذين المجالين), and topic-comment nominal sentences (والأكثر تخييبا للآمال هو أن، هم مركزون، وهذا له آثار). Interrogatives (هل، متى) terminate their sentence. What does NOT break: coordination continuing one predicate chain over a shared subject (وسوف تتطلب...وسوف تحدث), an adversative bound inside a single announced thesis frame (ولكننا لسنا مقتنعين inside بين نقيضين), colon-style elaboration (استراتيجية ذات مسارين مسار...ومسار...), apposition/enumeration, and interpolated rhetorical asides. Bibliographic lines are one unit each; the colophon's three parallel جميع حقوق النشر...محفوظة لـ clauses are three separate sentences. Observed mean sentence is about 25 tokens, so a 200-token paragraph carries roughly eight boundaries - this density check is what I used to arbitrate the coin-flip sites.
reasoning: (1) Colophon 137-173: three parallel 'جميع حقوق النشر الخاصة بـX محفوظة لـY' predications are run together on one line. Each is complete and the repeated جميع marks a fresh start, so I break at 148 هنداوي and 160 هنداوي (hi). (2) English block 175-239: segmented as English sentences at 180 Ltd, 183 Reserved, 196 Inc, 215 Wiley. 215 is safe ('No part of this book may be reproduced' is unambiguously new). 180 and 196 sit on abbreviation periods (Ltd. / Inc.) that are simultaneously sentence-final; these are my deliberate probe on whether the key breaks at abbreviation-final periods, and 180 is the weakest call in the whole document (lo). (3) Dedication 260-270: 'إلى زوجتي الحبيبة جين' is a bare PP while 'أنت مصدر إلهام لجميع دعاة حماية البيئة' is a full independent nominal clause. A terminal period and a vocative comma are equally idiomatic here; I break at 263 جين at lo purely to learn the convention for vocative/appositive dedications. (4) Acknowledgements 279-347: I take وكذلك نشكر (break at 296 عشر) and ويوجه الشكر أيضا (break at 336 الخطية) as new sentences because the adjacent paragraph 349-410 proves this writer opens sentences with 'كما يود أيضا شكر' (372) and 'وأخيرا يود شكر' (388) - the identical repeated-thanking-verb shape, and those two are unarguable. So the wa-initial twins get med rather than omission; if they are wrong I will learn that wa-initial repetition of a thanking verb stays inside one sentence. (5) 517-540: 'يحدث في هذه الحالة أن يتحد جميع البشر...من الخارج' is complete, then 'والتهديد الخطير لنا جميعا يعيد تعريف ما نرى أنه الآخر' is a topic-comment nominal sentence. Merged the pair is 24 tokens, exactly the corpus mean, which argues for one sentence; the topicalised nominal shape argues for two. I break at 530 الخارج at med. (6) 790-795 'متى سيتغير الموقف في قصتنا الرمزية': the question mark sits either after الموقف (792) or after الرمزية (795). I place it at 792 because the question is about the real world and 'في قصتنا الرمزية كان من الضروري الانتظار' is the allegory-framed ANSWER - كان is past tense, which fits a fronted PP frame, and the allegory's situation has already changed, which makes asking متى of it incoherent. med. (7) 962-968 'كيف يمكن للمرء ألا يكون مهتما بها' is an interpolated rhetorical question sitting inside 'فبدأنا باهتمام مشترك بالقضايا البيئية ... ولكن بخلفيتين علميتين مختلفتين تماما'. Breaking there would strand the ولكن clause as a fragment, so I break at neither 961 nor 968 even though a bracketed question mark almost certainly existed in the source. Sentence integrity outranks a stray terminal mark inside a parenthesis. (8) 1210-1218 quoted despair speech 'كان مؤتمر كوبنهاجن مخيبا للآمال / لقد ضاع كل شيء': لقد is a strong sentence-opening particle, but an Arabic comma inside a quotation is just as idiomatic. I break at 1214 للآمال at lo as a deliberate probe on quote-internal punctuation. 1218 شيء (end of the quote, before في الواقع) is certain. (9) 1375-1410: I do NOT break at 1389 before ولكننا لسنا مقتنعين, because the sentence is the explicitly announced بين نقيضين (between two extremes) frame and both poles belong to one predication. The same logic keeps 1448-1474 whole across وسوف تتطلب / وسوف تحدث - a tricolon of سوف clauses over the one shared subject هذه السياسات. (10) 1583-1586 'استراتيجية ذات مسارين مسار طبيعي ... ومسار غير طبيعي' is colon elaboration of مسارين, not a break. (11) 2074 'ولكن بنظرة أوسع لا يشكل ذلك فارقا كبيرا': omitted. A 14+8 token split is short for this text, and ولكن with fronted بنظرة أوسع reads as a comma-linked concessive tail of the same sentence. (12) The two giant paragraphs 581-788 (208 tokens) and 1092-1264 (173 tokens) are cut only at discourse pivots - 607 نحوها, 648 القطبين, 675 النهاية, 693 لديها, 717 مقنعة, 737 البديلة, 763 أقوى; and 1111, 1135, 1140, 1165, 1201, 1218, 1226, 1254 - giving 25-27 token means consistent with the rest of the document; every pivot is a fresh finite predication with its own subject, not a continuation of the previous predicate. (13) Chapter One paragraphs 1510-1698, 1700-1893 and 1895-2081 segment cleanly on the same openers (ولهذا السبب، يوجد، ففي هذه الحالة، قد تظهر، ولكن توجد؛ إن، من المهم أيضا، هم مركزون، وبالنسبة إليهم، ومن ثم، وهذا له، سوف نعود؛ كشف، ولما كانت، ومن ثم، ولكنه مع ذلك، والأكثر تخييبا) - these are all hi. (14) Format compliance: every token immediately preceding an <NL> carries a boundary (55 such positions including the final token 2081), and no <NL> token is ever marked.
